description: This Java class models the <entity-group-reader> XML element, parsing its attributes and child resource elements for configuration purposes within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityGroupReader
classes.description: A final class that represents the <entity-group-reader> element in the configuration, providing access to its attributes and resource list.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the 'name' attribute of the entity group reader.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Returns the list of Resource objects associated with this entity group reader.
